$comment: Temporary exceptions for scripts/audit-check.mjs. Each entry must name the advisory, why it is accepted, and an expiry date. Remove entries once the fix ships; expired entries fail CI.

advisories.reason: RCE via AVIF image optimization. Site uses imageService: 'passthrough', so Astro image optimization never runs on user input. Fixed by the Astro 7 / Cloudflare Workers migration.
Host header SSRF in prerendered error page fetch. Requires the Astro 6+ upgrade, which requires moving from Cloudflare Pages to Workers. Tracked in the Astro migration.
Reflected XSS via unescaped slot name. Site does not build slot names from request data. Fixed by the Astro 6+ upgrade tracked in the Astro migration.
